title: VPC Scaffolder: Terraform module for subnet zoning, multi-egress gateways, endpoint mirroring, and upgrade sentinels
creator: Aisha Kumar
description:
Goal: Provide a single, composable Terraform module (the 'VPC Scaffolder') that provisions AZ-aware subnet tiling, configurable egress gateway pools (NAT and IGW variants), endpoint mirror resources for cross-account service endpoints, and an upgrade sentinel for safe rolling upgrades. This module is aimed at Private (VPC) deployment customers who want reproducible, auditable networking topologies with built-in health checks and safe upgrade hooks.

Scope and features: 
- Subnet zoning: opinionated patterns to create control-plane, compute, and storage subnets per AZ with tags and IAM role associations. Support for custom CIDR tiling inputs and overlapping-check validations.
- Multi-egress gateways: allow defining primary and standby egress pools per AZ (NAT Gateways or IGWs) and automatic route table associations. Include automated failover via route priority and synthetic health checks.
- Endpoint mirroring: create VPC endpoints and optionally replicate endpoint configurations across accounts/regions (via terraform remote-state or data sources) so private deployments can access shared services with mirrored policies.
- Upgrade sentinel: an on-module-managed sentinel (automation hooks + synthetic probes) that prevents route/table changes during control-plane upgrades if health checks fail; integrates with rollout policies to pause/rollback.
- Health checks and observability: synthetic egress probes, endpoint connectivity checks, and CloudWatch/Datadog dashboards with prebuilt metrics and alert rules.
- Safe defaults and overrides: reasonable defaults for small-to-medium deployments, with override maps for enterprise topologies.

Acceptance criteria: 
1) Module accepts single input to produce a full, AZ-aware topology for a given VPC ID and CIDR plan.
2) Deployment run produces no drift on idempotent apply when using the same inputs.
3) Health checks created by the module surface metrics into Datadog and allow alerting on >50% failed probes across a rolling 5m window.
4) Upgrade sentinel stops changes to route tables and egress attachments if synthetic probes are failing, and exposes a manual override workflow for on-call.
5) End-to-end tests (terraform apply/destroy) succeed in our staging account and are covered by CI with a plan check step.

Design notes and trade-offs: 
- We intentionally avoid opinionated private DNS modifications; endpoint mirroring will configure policy and route attachments but not modify hosted zones.
- Using managed NAT Gateways by default keeps operational burden low but increases cost; we expose config to switch to HA NAT instances for cost-sensitive customers.
- The upgrade sentinel will be implemented as a small control-plane Lambda that reads a 'sentinel' state in SSM Parameter Store and reconciles with a state machine; this trades some operational complexity for a robust, observable guardrail.

Implementation plan: 
1) Module scaffolding (this ticket) — define inputs/outputs, core resources, and testing harness.
2) Health probe submodule — build synthetic egress probe resources + Datadog integration.
3) Endpoint mirror implementation — add remote-state support and cross-account role assumptions.
4) Sentinel automation — Lambda + step function + runbook + RBAC.
5) CI and e2e tests in staging account — add terraform-plan gating and canary apply job.

Rollout and migration: 
- Start with new Private deployments in staging; provide a migration doc for existing terraform stacks to adopt subnet tiling by importing resources.
- Canary rollout: enable the sentinel in monitoring-only mode for 2 weeks before enforcing block.

Security and compliance: 
- Module will support KMS encryption for SSM and logging outputs and configurable S3 bucket encryption for state.
- IAM roles created by the module will follow least-privilege patterns and support customer-managed role ARNs.

Documentation and deliverables: 
- README with examples for small, medium, and enterprise layouts.
- Migration playbook and troubleshooting runbook.
- Sample Datadog dashboard JSON and alert definitions.

Notes: this ticket focuses on the Terraform API and tests; separate tickets will track the console UI to surface sentinel state and migration support within Console.
